text:
Maya: Quick sketch idea
Rollback advisor: a compact panel that recommends a fallback during rollouts, shows cost estimate + confidence band, and offers simulate (shadow routing) before apply. figma: https://figma.com/proto/rollback-advisor
Jun: I like "advisor" better than "inspector". Less alarmist.
Sam: Important: quota-safety guard. If projected token burn > org threshold, block redirect and require admin approval.
Leia: Audit requirements: decision_id, action, operator, optional reason text. Keep 90d retention and BigQuery export. Redact PII in sampled snippets.
Tomas: Telemetry: emit structured event `fallback_advisor_event_v1` and add header `X-Fallback-Decision: <uuid>` to joined requests. Sampling for traces while advisor active (configurable).
ops-bot: ops-bot: canary check: route "chat-api" saw 2% error spike in 5m window
Maya: Advisor should default to "recommend gradual reduction" and surface a one-click "simulate shadow routing for 30s" that collects real deltas. If simulation matches projection, allow apply.
Jun: RBAC: roles = propose, apply-reduction, apply-redirect. UI should grey actions based on role.
Sam: Add auto-escalate path: if errors don't improve after hysteresis period, escalate to redirect (configurable) with cooldown to avoid oscillation.
Leia: UX: include a "why this fired" link that opens the raw signal + short explanation. Helps oncall triage.
Tomas: I'll draft proto + example BigQuery table and push PR. Use decision_token to join logs.
Maya: I'll update the figma with advisor flow, simulate modal, and cost/confidence visuals. Thanks all.
